seed.confirm:
A saka bayanan gwaji?

Wannan zai GOGE kowane aji da kowane ɗalibi a wannan makaranta, ya maye gurbinsu da saitin gwaji. Ba za a iya mayar da shi ba.

Ka yi haka ne kawai a makarantar gwaji.
seed.title: Kafa makarantar gwaji
seed.body: Yana cika wannan makaranta da saiti mai kama da na gaske mai rukunoni biyu a kowace shekara — azuzuwa 6, kusan ɗalibai 160 da aka tara bisa mataki a cikin shekaru daban-daban. Yana maye gurbin duk azuzuwan da ke akwai.

windowsPage.title: Lokutan Tantancewa
windowsPage.intro: Makarantu na tantancewa lokacin shiga da kuma a kowane rabin zango. Tsakanin waɗannan lokuta, malamai na ciyar da yara gaba a kan hanya ta amfani da hukuncinsu na ƙwararru — ba a yi wa yara jarrabawa ta hukuma bayan kowane littafi.
windowsPage.summary: Yara {{total}} a cikin azuzuwa {{classes}}. An tantance {{assessed}} a makonni 6 da suka gabata, {{remaining}} har yanzu ba a kammala ba. {{readyUp}} a shirye suke su hau mataki, an yi wa {{intervention}} alamar buƙatar ƙarin tallafi.

library.title: Ɗakin karatu
library.intro: Kayan koyo {{count}}+ masu alaƙa a cikin matakai 8 — kowane Littafin Sauti, Littafin Haɗa Sauti, Littafin Labari, sigar mu'amala, takardar aiki, tabarmar sauti da saitin kalmomi masu wuya, an tsara su bisa nau'i.
library.focus: Abin da aka mayar da hankali:
library.soundWorksheetDesc: Rubuta haruffa, gina kalmomi da rarraba sautuka. Abokin tafiyar <book>{{title}}</book>.
library.comingSoon: Na zuwa nan ba da jimawa ba
library.blendingDesc: Ƙaramin littafin A6 mai bayyana kalmomi. Babu takardar aiki daban — atisayen haɗa sauti shi ne kayan koyon kansa.
library.interactiveDesc: Kalmomin da ake iya taɓawa, bayyanar sautuka, sauti, rubutun kalma, jera labari, fahimta da atisayen rubutu.
library.interactiveDescGrammar: Kalmomin da ake iya taɓawa, bayyanar sautuka, sauti, rubutun kalma, jera labari, fahimta, jerin kalmomi bisa nahawu da atisayen rubutu.
library.packDesc: Fakitin A4 mai shafuka 5: farautar sauti, bi layi ka rubuta, karanta ka aikata, kalmomin baƙi (na ƙirƙira), labari da zane.
library.soundMatDesc: Jadawalin haɗin harafi da sauti mai tarawa wanda ke nuna sautukan da aka koyar a wannan mataki da matakan da suka gabata.
library.trickyCardsDesc: Katunan kalmomi masu wuya da aka gabatar a wannan mataki.
library.usedThroughout: Ana amfani da shi a duk tsawon matakin.
